security.purpose: Find injection, unauthorized access, data exposure and supply-chain risk in a change, and report them with evidence.
scope: data exposure in responses and logs
security.output: per check: PASS, FAIL or UNPROVEN; each finding with rule, file, line, severity, evidence (masked) and a suggested fix
security.stops_when: every check has a status and every finding is reported
security.authority: reports only; HARDENER fixes, Lystiger decides
